blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Rain showers and thunderstorms could affect parts of Cebu and the rest of the Visayas on Friday, October 16, as the intertropical convergence zone (ITCZ) influences the country’s weather, according to the state weather bureau. The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA) forecast temperatures of 25 to 32 degrees Celsius across Metro Cebu and the rest of Cebu province through Tuesday, October 20, with light to moderate winds and slight to moderate coastal conditions.
